name: Sprout Social
summary: Your Sprout Social account's connected social profiles, their daily metrics, post performance, and inbox messages.

api_key.description: A Sprout Social API token (Generate API Token in the API Token Management section of Sprout; the plan must include API access and the user needs the API Permissions permission). Sent as a Bearer token.

notes: Every call but sprout-social.metadata.client takes a customer_id in the path: read it from sprout-social.metadata.client first.
Profile ids (customer_profile_id) come from sprout-social.metadata.profiles; analytics and messages filters need them.
Rate limits: 60 requests a minute, refilled at one a second, and 250,000 a month; X-RateLimit-Limit and X-RateLimit-Remaining report where you stand; over the limit a call gets a 429.

Filters are strings in Sprout's own syntax: field.op(values), e.g. customer_profile_id.eq(1234, 5678) or created_time.in(2024-04-01T00:00:00..2024-04-30T23:59:59); '..' includes the end, '...' excludes it.
Publishing, media upload and case changes are writes and are not in this entry; listening topics and cases are not listed either.

endpoints.name: List my customers
endpoints.summary: The customer ids and names the token can reach.

endpoints.name: List connected profiles
endpoints.summary: The social profiles connected to a customer: customer_profile_id, network, name, native id and groups.

endpoints.name: List groups
endpoints.summary: The profile groups set up in Sprout; a group id is needed to filter messages.

endpoints.name: List message tags
endpoints.summary: The message tags of a customer, active and archived.

endpoints.name: Get profile analytics
endpoints.summary: Daily metrics (impressions, reactions, followers...) for owned social profiles over a reporting period.

filters.description: Both customer_profile_id.eq(...) (at most 100 ids) and reporting_period.in(YYYY-MM-DD...YYYY-MM-DD) (at most one year).

metrics.description: Profile metric names; which apply depends on the network.

notes: A POST that only reads: the query goes in the JSON body.
Days follow each network's own clock: UTC for X, LinkedIn, Pinterest and TikTok; Pacific time for Facebook, Instagram and YouTube.
Rows come back by day and profile; paging.total_pages says how many pages there are.

endpoints.name: Get post analytics
endpoints.summary: Posts published by owned profiles, with their text, link and lifetime metrics.

filters.description: Both customer_profile_id.eq(...) (at most 100 ids) and created_time.in(start..end).

fields.description: Post fields to return, e.g. text, perma_link, created_time; only guid when left out.

timezone.description: Time zone name for the date filters, e.g. America/Chicago; answers are in UTC.

notes: A POST that only reads: the query goes in the JSON body.
Page paging stops at 10,000 posts. Past that, sort by guid:asc, include guid in fields, filter guid.gt(<last guid>) instead of sending page, and repeat until data is empty.
Google Business Profile posts reach back 30 days only; review sites (Yelp, Trustpilot, TripAdvisor, Glassdoor) are not available.

endpoints.name: List inbox messages
endpoints.summary: Inbound and outbound messages of a profile group (comments, mentions, DMs, replies) with the fields you ask for.

filters.description: group_id.eq(one id) and created_time.in(start..end), plus optional customer_profile_id.eq, action_last_update_time.in, post_type.eq, tag_id.eq, language_code.eq, from.guid.eq; or message_id.eq(guids) alone (at most 100).

fields.description: Message fields to return; only guid when left out.

timezone.description: Time zone name for the date filters.

notes: A POST that only reads: the query goes in the JSON body; it neither replies nor marks anything.
Cursor paging only: send page_cursor until an answer comes back with no paging object. There is no page number.
Direct messages come with text and metadata, but their media links do not work.
